arxiv:2024.12345.introduction: We present CodeGen, a family of large language models trained on code. CodeGen models demonstrate strong performance on code generation benchmarks.
arxiv:2024.12345.method: Our method employs a hierarchical checkpointing strategy that selectively stores activations at different granularities.
arxiv:2024.12345.results: Experiments on GPT-2 and BERT models show 35-42% memory reduction with less than 5% training time overhead.

arxiv:2024.12346.related_work: Prior work on neural program synthesis has focused on template-based approaches and grammar-constrained generation.
arxiv:2024.12346.experiment: We evaluate on the MBPP and HumanEval benchmarks, achieving state-of-the-art results across multiple programming languages.
